name: Dragon Con
blurb: The largest multi-media pop-culture convention in the US, spanning sci-fi, fantasy, comics, gaming, literature, art, music and film each Labor Day weekend in Atlanta.

editions.venue: Hyatt Regency Atlanta, Marriott Marquis, Hilton, Sheraton & Westin Peachtree Plaza (downtown Atlanta)
editions.evidence: Wayback Machine snapshot (2026-09-28) of the homepage: 'Sep. 2 – Sep. 6, 2027 in Atlanta, GA' and a countdown reading '338 Days ... BUY NOW FOR 2027'

notes: The live dragoncon.org timed out on every attempt (default Chromium x2, msedge channel x1 - each hit the renderer's 45s navigation timeout rather than showing a bot wall), so home and guests were both pulled from Wayback Machine snapshots instead. The only reachable guests-page snapshot (2026-09-04, mid-weekend of the Sep 3-7, 2026 show) is that show's own guest list, not the 2027 one, so per the 'last year's lineup' rule guests is 'none-yet' rather than carrying those names forward; it is also a heavily JS/alphabet-tab driven page that did not expand into real guest-photo candidates even where rendered. Venue is Dragon Con's long-standing multi-hotel downtown-Atlanta setup, not independently re-confirmed this pass. Organizer and the 2027 dates are confirmed directly from the archived homepage.
